purpose: Define bounded Cloud Paper result storage and exhaustion behavior; this policy does not prove production account usage or authorize runtime activation.

scope.hard_stop_trigger: BLOCK before a write when observed + pending + current-run projected storage is greater than or equal to the hard-stop ceiling.
scope.shared_account_note: The 31-day growth is a theoretical project envelope, not reserved capacity. Other account writers and actual account-wide headroom remain unverified.

retention.cleanup_requires: A separate versioned authority that preserves frozen evidence and verifies exact target objects.

exhaustion.warning_trigger: Fresh complete account-wide observed plus pending storage reaches the warning threshold.
exhaustion.unknown_or_stale_usage: BLOCKED_BUDGET; no provider or storage access
exhaustion.partial_write_recovery: Preserve evidence and report REVIEW_REQUIRED; no automatic cleanup or takeover.
